text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: —It wasn't my first time.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Back when we first enrolled, the three of 
us raced over 2,400m on turf. That race 
was the spark that somehow brought us all 
together—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Still, it wasn't the first time.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
You probably don't remember, but that 
wasn't the first time I ever ran alongside 
you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: —Hayahide.

text_block_list.name: Young Taishin
text_block_list.text: *gasp*, *wheeze*, *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Taking 1st place in the Kiddie Race is 
Biwa Hayahide-chan! Crossing the finish 
line together with Narita Brian-chan in 
2nd, a wonderful sister finish!!
(Clap, clap, clap, clap!)

text_block_list.name: Young Brian
text_block_list.text: Dammit!! Big Sis really is fast...!

text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fufun. I'm not gonna lose to my little 
sister just yet!

text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's head back and have a review 
session, Brian! We're gonna enter the 
Twinkle Series together, so we gotta get a 
whole lot stronger!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Those sisters from earlier were amazing~! 
Even though it was just a kids' race, I 
think that's the first time I've ever seen 
someone run that fast!

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Her physique is already so well-developed 
at this stage; she seems to have a very 
promising future ahead of her.

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to the Twinkle Series 
those girls will run in one day!

text_block_list.name: Taishin's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"...Taishin? What's wrong? Are you still 
hurting somewhere...?"

text_block_list.name: Young Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Not really. ...I'm fine.

text_block_list.name: Taishin's Mother
text_block_list.text: I see... ...Hey, Taishin.

text_block_list.name: Young Taishin
text_block_list.text: ? ...What?

text_block_list.name: Taishin's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"You wish you'd been born bigger, don't 
you? ...I'm sorry."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: (...Ah, dammit.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...I have to train on my own. The Kikuka 
Sho is right around the corner, after 
all...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ngh...... *cough* *cough*!! *hack*――

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(Whoa... What's with all the crazy 
commotion...?)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hyaa, look at that burst of speed! Isn't 
that final 3-furlong time insane!?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Ever since the summer camp ended, 
Hayahide-san's been kind of incredible...! 
I wonder what's gonna happen in the Kikuka 
Sho!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Haya... Hide...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Nnngh!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ah, Taishin! It's Taishiiin—!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Ticket.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, hey, did you see Hayahide run!?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: That was sooo amazing, wasn't it?!―― I—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I just thought, 'I'm totally not gonna 
lose!'!!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: ...Huh, Taishin? What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: You're looking a bit pale—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Whoa!? W-Wait up, Taishin...っ!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*...!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(Run... Run, run, put in more miles! At 
this rate, it won't be enough...!!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(Watching Hayahide run, I couldn't even 
picture a way to win! Yet Ticket never 
broke!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(At this rate, I'll be... I'll be the only 
one left behind...!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Haaah, haaah... Wheeze... haaah.........!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: —*cough, hack*... *hurk*!!

text_block_list.name: Passerby C
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Hey, are you okay!? You're looking 
pale...!

text_block_list.name: Passerby C
text_block_list.text: A-An ambulanceââ!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(I'm the only one... being left... 
behind...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(Am I back to being the me that nobody 
acknowledges, the me that just gets made 
fun of...?)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...I was running, I know I was... When did 
I...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
choice_data_list:
Anyway, let's just take it easy and rest 
for now.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? What are you talking about!! The 
Kikuka Sho is right around the corner, we 
don't have time for—

She really must not be feeling well yet. 
With no trace of her usual fiery spirit, 
Narita Taishin's shoulders slumped 
dejectedly.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
—Excuse me. Oh, thank goodness, it seems 
you've regained consciousness.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ah... Yes.

The doctor finished the examination while 
asking Narita Taishin and me a few 
questions. And then—

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
To be completely honest with you—I cannot 
recommend running in the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Huh...!? Wh-What's that about...!? I'm not 
even injured anywhere!!

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Yes, there are no injuries, but... The 
exam results show mild inflammation in her 
respiratory system.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
You're feeling fatigued as well, right? I 
believe it would be difficult to fully 
recover from all of this before the Kikuka 
Sho.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
It is completely out of the question... I 
don't believe I can adequately demonstrate 
my true ability.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: No way......

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
...That is my assessment as a doctor. 
Beyond that, please discuss it thoroughly 
with your Trainer and decide together.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, then.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Because I will run.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I'm running in the Kikuka Sho, so get 
ready.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Please, I'm begging you!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Please, I'm begging you... Don't tell me 
not to run.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"All I have is racing. All I can do is run 
and win...!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Please, Trainer. If I can't run, I—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...There won't be anything left...!

To Narita Taishin, pleading with tears 
spilling over—
I was unable to shake my head in denial.
